name: Amankila
insider_take: Perched dramatically on a clifftop overlooking the Lombok Strait, Amankila feels like a sacred temple floating above Bali's untamed eastern coast.
whats_special: This architectural masterpiece features a three-tiered infinity pool that appears to cascade into the ocean, while its traditional Balinese pavilions offer unobstructed views of Mount Agung. The property sits on a former coconut plantation and maintains its own private beach club accessible via a dramatic clifftop funicular.
pro_tip: Book the Pool Suite for the ultimate experience – you'll have direct access to the iconic tiered pools and can enjoy sunset cocktails without crowds.
dont_miss: The sunrise trek to nearby Mount Agung (Bali's highest peak), snorkeling at Virgin Beach just minutes away, and the traditional Tenganan village – one of Bali's oldest settlements where ancient weaving traditions continue unchanged for over 700 years.
pros: Dramatic clifftop location with breathtaking ocean views
Three-tiered infinity pool design overlooking the sea
Authentic Balinese architecture and cultural immersion
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Secluded luxury retreat away from crowded tourist areas
cons: Remote location requires longer transfers from airport
